verdict.rationale: n8n's GitHub README and docs consistently tout '1500+ integrations' and thousands of templates, backed by an integrations directory covering major SaaS apps (Slack, Notion, GitHub, HubSpot, Jira, etc.) and a long list of built-in credential types, and community users corroborate ease of extending/using integrations in production. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that all listed integrations are vendor-maintained (vs. community-contributed nodes) and independent benchmarking of integration reliability/coverage depth.
